name: mosio
description: Make short motion videos for small businesses and creators: promos, social content, explainers, ads and announcements as animated typography and motion graphics. Vertical for Reels, TikTok and WhatsApp Status, plus square, portrait and wide. Claude directs the video from a recipe or fills in a ready design, and Mosio renders the MP4. No AI image, video or audio generation: the motion is written as code.
